fixes.replace: As you move one of your hands, you're going to move deliberately, and as soon as you stop moving deliberately, you'll focus on what you've got.
fixes.with: Pair a small repeated hand movement with increasing clarity; stop the movement and notice what remains.
fixes.note: restores the step: a small repeated hand movement with growing clarity, then stop and notice what remains

fixes.replace: If some comes back up, I let it, and send it on down again. If nothing comes back, I just keep sending mine.
fixes.with: If something comes back up, I let it, and send my love on down again. If nothing comes back, I just keep sending mine, and listening.
fixes.note: whatever comes back from the child is received, 'it' is anchored, and the listening step is back

fixes.replace: At some point in time you can add this, but you must say you are doing it before doing it.
fixes.with: Fractionation means returning toward ordinary awareness and then deciding whether to enter absorption again. Used openly, it teaches that trance has a door in both directions. At some point in time you can add this, but you must say you are doing it before doing it; every answer cannot secretly mean “deeper.”
fixes.note: says what fractionation is, what using it openly teaches, and why you name it first; gives 'this' a referent

fixes.replace: As you wait and release the responsibility of making it happen
fixes.with: As you wait, you release the responsibility of making anything happen.
fixes.note: makes the fragment a full sentence; 'anything' replaces the unanchored 'it'
any induction that works for you, not an unnamed one above

fixes.replace: Say the word and/ or do the phrase
fixes.with: Say the word and/ or phrase
fixes.note: a phrase is said, not done

fixes.replace: When you pick the time and place (it needs to be an appropriate time and place), say the word and/ or do the phrase to begin going into this state that you picked, and are familiar with. It's fine to change the direction you are going in, or stop this at any point.
fixes.with: Give your cue the meaning you choose: "When you pick the time and place (it needs to be an appropriate time and place), and say the word and/ or phrase to begin, you can go into this state that you picked, and are familiar with. It's fine to change the direction you are going in, or stop this at any point."
fixes.note: makes this the meaning you give the cue, said to yourself, not a usage instruction; fixes 'do the phrase'

fixes.with: the altered state will be over for today
fixes.note: says it's today's altered state that ends, not the kept cue

fixes.replace: All the instructions you have given me to carry me deeper
fixes.with: All the instructions to carry me deeper
fixes.note: drops the unnamed 'you' from the first-person script
reads as: you needn't go through every kind
'it' had no referent; says sadness or tension doesn't mean you have to stop

fixes.replace: It's also ok to use phrases that you didn't think in your head - if something comes up that you're analyzing, it's still good to analyze, even if it's not in your head already.
fixes.with: A sentence you find now can help examine the meaning without being a sentence you thought then.
fixes.note: says words found now can help examine a meaning that came without words

fixes.with: any deeper, truer, or more reliable
fixes.note: names the measures: deeper, truer, more reliable
